summary.zh: 让界面满足 WCAG 2.2 无障碍要求

description.zh: 检查并调整对比度、焦点顺序、ARIA 语义与读屏器体验，使产品符合 WCAG 2.2。适合上线前的无障碍审查、移动端适配，以及为辅助技术用户补全操作路径。
description.en: Reviews and fixes contrast, focus order, ARIA semantics, and screen reader behavior so a product meets WCAG 2.2. Useful for pre-launch audits, mobile accessibility, and supporting assistive technology users.
